summary: Hono transport adapters. Product contracts and authorization remain in shared contracts and the corresponding service ports.

key_files.asset-capability.ts: Consumes existing signed Resource capabilities. Project replica multipart requests recheck admission and exact references; generic preview/range streaming retains its existing policy.
key_files.project-content-transfer.ts: Shared HTTP glue for Resource and Document all-PUT multipart phases and exact-length streaming responses. No client storage locator, ETag or resource list is accepted as authority.
key_files.project-content-transfer.test.ts: Checks incremental response delivery, actual overflow/truncation failure and explicit unsupported storage without buffered fallback.
key_files.v1/project-content.ts: Project Resource capability issuance and immutable Document body transport; authoritative Loro references and current exact replica admission gate every request.
